records.name: ROCKSDB_XXH3_64bits
records.observation: XXH3-family 64-bit hash, default secret (table at 0x97ec80 in .rodata), seed 0; the short branches match public XXH3_64bits line by line (verified against the Ruby prism xxh3.c port of upstream xxHash: 1-to-3, 4-to-8 and 9-to-16 formulas); len 0 returns 0x2d06800538d394c2 (the published XXH3_64bits empty-input value, also derived here as avalanche_XXH64(secret[56..64) ^ secret[64..72))); len 1 returns 0xe6c632b61e964e1f (the published XXH3_64bits(b"a") value); len 1..3 uses the XXH64 avalanche (h *= PRIME64_2, h ^= h>>29, h *= PRIME64_3, h ^= h>>32); len 4..8 uses rrmxmx; len 9..16 uses a 128-bit product fold plus the XXH3 avalanche; no census record

default XXH3 secret, read from .rodata; the short-branch immediates are XORs of its words: C1 = secret[24..32) ^ secret[32..40), C2 = secret[40..48) ^ secret[48..56), 4-to-8 bitflip = secret[8..16) ^ secret[16..24), 1-to-3 bitflip = secret[0..4) ^ secret[4..8)

records.note: transliterated model cross-checked against an independent reference formulation on every case; the binary itself was never executed
